entry_point: Existing Render workspace, single RENDER ribbon tab. SCENE and IMAGE remain ribbon groups; browse SELENE using the local Scenes collection in the shared resource browser.

simple_flow.label: Choose a scene
simple_flow.content: Browse the twelve prepared SELENE shots in the local Scenes category; inspect the selected subject, source requirements and appearance fidelity.
simple_flow.behavior: Keep selection and hover as reversible presentation previews. Resolve the scene draft, capabilities and lock conflicts before an explicit future atomic Apply. No complete-scene apply is registered by this specification.

simple_flow.label: Choose quality
simple_flow.content: Show three exact catalog profile recommendations for the selected shot, with All quality profiles available in the same selector.
simple_flow.behavior: Keep camera and appearance locks. Show dimensions, work budget and actual availability. Every referenced Q profile is currently specified_unbound; a lower quality choice never removes shot optical or source requirements.

simple_flow.label: Render
simple_flow.content: Resolve pending edits, run the current preflight/start workflow when the applied request is supported, then show actual status, Cancel and Export actions.
simple_flow.behavior: Render start captures the applied request. Cancel or job failure preserves the applied scene and source; it does not undo an earlier Apply. Raw/finished comparison appears only when the executor supplies both results.

controls.primary_adjustment_count_policy: Scene and quality selectors are excluded. Show only controls meaningful to the current selection and actual executor; move additional adjustments to sections.

disclosure.quick_behavior: Default collapsed inspector sections for the current selection.
disclosure.detailed_behavior: Expand relevant resource, layer, mapping, camera and lighting sections in the same inspector.
disclosure.expert_behavior: Expand numerical transport, resource, provenance and output sections in the same inspector.
disclosure.state_policy: Disclosures never change quality, reset values or apply a scene; remember expansion and focus per document and context.

advanced_groups: surface layers, mapping and physical detail scale
emitters, source ownership and lighting normalization
terrain detail, seed and memory budget
camera projection, clipping, focus and depth of field
sampling, convergence, denoising and color output
source versions, validation evidence and reproduction manifest
controls.selection_policy: Contextual controls identify the exact body, face or supported instance scope. Shared body or component edits state every affected occurrence; current native overlays do not support independent occurrence styling.
controls.unsupported_policy: Show the missing capability and relevant next action; expanding Detailed or Expert never enables unsupported fields.
controls.quick_context_policy: The quick list is the default lunar-scene context. Selecting an appearance, studio or camera replaces that list with the relevant contextual adjustments; these lists are never combined.

availability_states.meaning: A conceptual requirement only; an attractive card is not a rendered asset.

availability_states.action: Open prepared material swatches in a new isolated document
availability_states.meaning: The existing-command script is prepared and statically checked but unexecuted here. Actual execution and preflight are required; this specification does not register an in-app action.

availability_states.action: Inspect the required improved model and source record
availability_states.meaning: Model-specific targets remain unresolved until the improved native file is pinned and reviewed.
The requested optical scene cannot be silently replaced by its opaque projection.

availability_states.action: Apply the resolved scene and render when implemented
availability_states.meaning: A future state requiring source binding, actual executor support, successful preflight and recorded validation evidence. No committed shot currently claims this state.

defaults.detail_policy: Detailed and Expert are inspector section disclosures, not global modes.
defaults.physical_mode_policy: This is the initial lunar shot policy. Selecting a declared studio or editorial shot uses that shot policy explicitly rather than changing a global interface mode.
defaults.earth_and_stars: Off until a separately reviewed site/time/orientation/exposure binding enables them.
defaults.unsupported_feature: Block the affected shot and list all missing source or executor requirements.
defaults.preview_fallback: Explicit appearance or shot variant with an approximation label retained in the saved request.

accessibility: Complete search, filtering, card selection, parameter edit, Apply, Discard, preflight, Render, Cancel and Export by keyboard without dragging.
Use the existing UI kit focus treatment, text scaling and accessibility bridge; keep focused controls visible in narrow panels.
Provide readable labels and semantic names in addition to thumbnails, status colors and approved icons.
Virtualized resources expose stable selection, focused item position and filtered result count; loading more items never steals focus.
Blocked controls explain missing requirements through text available to assistive technology.
Numeric fields include units, direct entry, reset and meaningful bounds without changing engineering values.
Return focus to the initiating control after a dialog or diagnostic; progress updates never seize focus.
Throttle screen-reader progress announcements by meaningful phase or result changes.
Reduced motion disables automatic turntables, camera transitions and decorative preview animation while preserving readable progress.
An explicit Preview and Apply path complements temporary hover or drag previews.
integration_rules: Follow the authoritative integration_contract for current source/layout/component mappings.
Keep the existing Render workspace and single RENDER ribbon tab; SCENE and IMAGE are groups, with future capability-gated extensions inside that structure.
Use the shared segmented selector, section and Panel components, theme::Tokens and approved icon assignments.
Scenes, Materials, Lighting and Environments are local library categories rather than additional workspaces or ribbon tabs.
Use navigation::handle and existing selection behavior; do not add an independent camera controller.
Keep resource resolution and validation in the engine and use the registered command authorities for supported state changes.
Preserve native/source locks and engineering or motion state; keep render drafts local to their document.
Catalog JSON and this flow describe intent; no new production UI, quality profile adapter or scene-apply command is claimed.
acceptance: A first-time user can find a prepared shot, identify every current blocker and inspect three exact quality recommendations without opening Expert.
Quick, Detailed and Expert disclosures preserve one scene, one quality choice and pending edits; they introduce no new ribbon tabs or global modes.
At most six primary adjustment controls are visible at once, excluding scene and quality selectors.
Opening material swatches creates a fresh isolated document and leaves the current and source designs unchanged; the prepared script remains labelled unexecuted until runtime evidence exists.
Search across the full catalog preserves filters, focus and scroll, reports counts honestly and does not count projections as additional material concepts.
Locked camera, appearance, source and motion fields survive compatible preset changes; conflicts are visible before mutation.
All scene recommendations retain specified_unbound status until actual resource, executor and source checks resolve them.
An expert can trace every applied value, source hash and capability decision through the same command path.
Cancel, failed jobs and unsupported requests preserve the native source and do not discard pending drafts or silently undo applied scene edits.
Appearance edits never change density, inertia, friction, joint limits or approved motion.
The complete workflow is usable by keyboard, at increased text scale and with reduced motion, with meaningful assistive-technology labels.

quality_selection.profile_identity_policy: Resolve labels, dimensions and budgets from the referenced Q record; no independent Preview/Portfolio/Lunar Master labels or competing Preview/Final mode switch.
quality_selection.availability_policy: All listed profiles are specified_unbound authoring targets. The current opaque swatch renderer is a separate prepared-input path and does not implement these path-tracing profiles.
quality_selection.compatibility_policy: Union the selected profile requirements with the shot, stage and material requirements before admission; recommendations are not silent feature reductions.
quality_selection.blocked_choice_behavior: Keep a blocked profile inspectable with its concrete missing requirements; do not enable Render or relabel it as a supported preset.

library.category_policy: One local selector inside the existing Render layout; these are not workspaces or ribbon tabs.
library.count_policy: Show the selected resource-type total and filtered result count. Link the 48 prepared opaque projections to their material concepts without presenting them as 48 additional concepts.
library.state_policy: Preserve query, filters, focused result, selection and scroll per document and category when opening an inspector or switching contexts.
library.large_list_policy: Virtualize rows and thumbnail work, keep stable item identity and accessible positions, and load content on demand without freezing geometry input.
library.empty_result_policy: Retain the query, identify active filters and offer Clear filters.
library.preview_policy: Use declared comparable reference lighting and label concept images, actual renders and missing previews distinctly; current-scene preview is a separate explicit action.

availability_evaluation.multiple_blockers: Show all relevant blockers together; the display states above are not a mutually exclusive runtime state machine.
availability_evaluation.runtime_readiness: Data-validation success and authored status do not establish runtime UI registration, replay success or visual validation.
availability_evaluation.current_executable_input: The standalone swatch JSON can be replayed by a compatible built CLI in a new design after actual runtime checks; no SELENE native model is needed for that separate action.
availability_evaluation.enablement_rule: A future in-app Render action is enabled only from actual resolved runtime state, not the illustrative availability table.

swatch_opening.execution_scope: Fresh isolated document session using the existing new-document workflow; never the source or current working document session.
swatch_opening.applied_scene_effect: None in existing documents. The script creates its own swatch geometry and appearances.
swatch_opening.fidelity: Uniform opaque previews only; no transmission, LED emission, procedural textures or advanced optical support is implied.

draft_and_lock_policy.document_scope: Pending values, inspector expansion and library navigation belong to their originating document and shot.
draft_and_lock_policy.navigation_behavior: Switching library categories, sections, ribbon tabs or documents preserves drafts without applying or discarding them.
draft_and_lock_policy.pending_edits: Show pending versus applied values and explicit Apply/Discard actions. Resolve the draft before Render, or explicitly render the identified applied shot; never mix them silently.
draft_and_lock_policy.close_behavior: Use the existing unsaved-work flow when closing a document; do not invent another global save mode.
draft_and_lock_policy.conflict_policy: Resolve conflicts before mutation. Keep locked values only if the complete request remains compatible; otherwise offer explicit Unlock and apply, Create a shot copy or Cancel.
draft_and_lock_policy.fit_policy: Fit once on explicit request, only when applicable framing locks permit it; output-aspect changes disclose their framing consequence.
draft_and_lock_policy.source_policy: Never modify the accepted native source, engineering materials, native geometry, joint limits or approved motion through render controls.
draft_and_lock_policy.lunar_policy: Physical lunar shots keep atmosphere, automatic sky fill and undeclared editorial sources disabled, with one owned Sun contribution.
draft_and_lock_policy.comparison_policy: A/B locks are local comparison conditions and do not silently alter persistent user locks.
draft_and_lock_policy.job_policy: Render start captures applied state. Cancel, failure and export act on the owned job; they do not undo a prior scene apply or redirect to another document.
draft_and_lock_policy.current_settings_boundary: Current settings/camera drafts retain their existing save-optional render-request behavior. Future resource drafts must resolve explicitly; Save Setup is not a mandatory extra click before every image.

registered_authorities.purpose: Apply a validated supported appearance to an explicit scope.
Read existing saved render setup values.
Validate and save supported render setup intent.
Apply an existing saved camera setup through its current contract.
Inspect read-only evaluated product-scene metadata; this neither applies a scene preset nor captures a render job.
Read current capability and resource admission diagnostics; not a queue reservation or whole-scene apply.
Capture applied scene state and start a supported owned job.
Read actual job phases and results without waiting or rendering.
Export the explicitly identified retained result with current path and overwrite rules.

future_proposals.purpose: Future read-only dependency, ownership, lock and capability resolution.
Future atomic resolved scene application with one undo record.

command_bindings.alias_policy: Do not create parallel render.appearance.assign, render.job.start or render.job.cancel aliases for existing commands.
command_bindings.registration_policy: This JSON is an integration specification, not runtime command or UI registration.
